dedupe_keys.name: urban plaza microclimate agent based model of pedestrian shade seeking 29 3 square da nang

description: This NetLogo model studies how pedestrians seek shade and interact with the microclimate in an urban square, calibrated on weekday observations at 29-3 Square in Da Nang, Vietnam. It tracks the sun's angle and projects shadows dynamically around obstacles at 2 m per patch, and agents follow dual feedback rules: heat builds up and recovers, they stay in shade once found, actively look for shade and leave the square when too hot. The published scenario is a two-row tree layout. It was produced by Anh Tuan Nguyen of the University of Science and Technology, The University of Da Nang, and published on Zenodo on 5 September 2026 to accompany an article submitted to the university's Journal of Science and Technology. Coverage: one plaza in Da Nang. Access: free source code as a text file on Zenodo; needs NetLogo 7.0.2 or newer. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: one site and one tree scenario; the article was not yet published when read. Simulation uses are testing tree and shade layouts of squares for heat exposure of people using them. Related records: the Belo Horizonte outdoor thermal comfort survey and the UDF of Urban Microclimate.
